I really need help getting this under control so I can start enjoying things like hiking again.

I also use it a couple of times a week at night when I wake up needing relief. I was given a pulmonary function test during my last office visit, and the results were consistent with asthma. I haven't had any imaging studies done for my asthma.
Doctor: Could you please describe any specific triggers or situations that seem to worsen your asthma symptoms, such as allergens, exercise, or changes in weather? Additionally, have you noticed any patterns in your symptoms, such as worsening during certain times of the day or week?
